steps.content: Hamel tiptoes and lands on the filthy fluid gracefully.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: They're giving you a warm welcome.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Why don't we all have some fun together? It's too dark, too cold here. Why don't we all go to the Carnival together?
Hamel goes through the black mist and walks toward you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't you dare come near him!
steps.female_content: Don't you dare come near her!

steps.content: The Nightmare growls and rushes toward Hamel, attacking her.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Argh!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Did it hit her?!
The attack did hit her. Hamel's chest is hollowed out and her figure is beginning to blur.

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Why... Why are you so mean to Hamel?
You hear Hamel's sobs.

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Why don't you love Hamel?

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Hamel loves all of you so much... Why do you hate Hamel?
The illusion before you is sobbing indignantly like a little child, wiping the tears on her cheeks with her two hands, as if completely oblivious of the massive hole in her chest.

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Sob... Mom... <size=44>Mom...</size>
Crying, the illusion turns and runs behind that enormous curtain and returns into the Black Ring. After that, the mad Corruptors are beginning to disperse.
Everything becomes silent again. The blue light from the base station shines faintly upon the speechless group.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Is something wrong in her head?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Indeed. She's always been taciturn. And at the peak of Hamel's fame, rumors about her mental issues were rampant online.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: As if validating these rumors, during her last performance, Hamel stood blankly on the grand stage for half an hour and then passed out. After that, she vanished for two years, only reappearing before the public when BR-001 broke out.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: The dance prodigy who hung the moon became a murderous witch. Some say the Black Ring at the Carnival was her revenge on the DisCity...

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: What do you think? Sounds like a Mania-themed urban legend, right?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I can't guarantee that. It happened too long ago, before the 9th Agency was even established. All I can say for sure is that she'll be a very challenging enemy.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: To defeat the real her, the only way is to enter the Black Ring.
Before you can answer, a voice comes in through the speaker on Langley.

steps.speaker: Agent from the 9th Agency
steps.content: Madam, my apologies. This woman insists on speaking to you directly, she...
Before the agent finishes, you hear some background noise. Someone has grabbed the communication device. You hear Nightingale's familiar voice and the uncharacteristic anxiety in it.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What exactly do you want? Where did you take Chief to?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Relax, Miss Adjutant. Your Chief is right next to me, looking refreshed after his outdoor break.
steps.female_content: Relax, Miss Adjutant. Your Chief is right next to me, looking refreshed after her outdoor break.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm fine. The Sinners are with me too.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I see... That's good...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Please tell me your location and I'll come and pick you up right away. I won't let you go through any more interrogations or let the 9th Agency take you away.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Are you sure you want to do that? This is your Chief's proposal, after all.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Your Chief wants to take on the first Black Ring and destroy it. Don't you think this is the best way to clear up all the suspicions?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You're at the Rust?!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, you can't go there. You're still dealing with the after-effects of the Black Ring in the square, and it almost took your life. BR-001 caused over 30 times the casualties done by the Black Ring in the square! It's too dangerous!

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: The power behind the Black Rings has begun their action. They won't spare anyone who has damaged a Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Until when can you cover him up? You want him to just sit out this crisis and wait for his death?
steps.female_content: Until when can you cover her up? You want her to just sit out this crisis and wait for her death?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Are you egging him on?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Listen to me, Chief. The 9th Agency has no right to force you to do anything. I'm already going through the procedures to clarify the facts and clear up any doubts around you. You don't need to risk this.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I understand you may not have faith in me, but please don't put yourself in danger again!
Her voice is sincere but urgent, reminding you of how she risked her own life to protect you when you first met.
But you've already made up your mind.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Nightingale, it's my own decision to investigate the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The 9th Agency never forced me, I was the one who proposed it. I'm not doing it to clear up the suspicions around me, but to find out the truth. There are answers I want to look for.
With the little trust you have from the authorities, you don't know if you'll get another chance to approach a Black Ring.

And the closer you get to Black Rings, the firmer your belief becomes—the belief that the confusion the Black Ring has brought you can only be resolved by the Black Ring itself. The mysteries, the enemies, the source—you must search for the truth.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Trust me, and wait for my return.
This is my own battle, don't hold me back.

steps.content: You cut off the communication.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Done talking?
You nod. You look toward the two Sinners and see complex expressions on both of their faces.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...You must go?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you don't have to follow me. I mean it. I'm a suspect being suspended for investigations. You don't need to listen to my orders.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's my duty to protect you.
She comes next to you. Hella clenches her fists and clicks her tongue impatiently, catching up with you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This time your shackles are not linked to that Corpseborne, so I guess the Black Ring won't affect us. Don't touch anything weird once you get in!
The fact that they're willing to come with you makes you both reassured and worried.
Langley gives a gentle smile, watching the three of you.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Just as I thought, you're an interesting person. If you make it out alive, why don't you transfer to the 9th Agency?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He's not leaving the Bureau. ${PlayerName} is our Chief.
steps.female_content: She's not leaving the Bureau. ${PlayerName} is our Chief.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Haha, you're right. The MBCC people are all so adorable. It'll be a pity if you die here.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Tell me, what do you need? Other than people, I can get you anything. You see, I must be careful when it comes to my subordinates' lives too.
The mental contamination behind the Black Ring is so overwhelming, that without the shackles, even Sinners can't handle the corruption, let alone ordinary people.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No need to prepare anything. Regular preparation doesn't do anything to the Black Ring, we can only fight it ourselves.
You hesitate briefly and turn to face Langley. She's freed you—regardless of the reason behind.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Thank you for giving me this opportunity.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you want me to do anything for you, just tell me, and I'll do my best. I don't mind you taking advantage of me.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Don't worry too much. This is not a mission you can accomplish with a distracted mind, so focus on your objective. What I'm after will come itself.
You nod. As you turn and are about to step out and leave, suddenly, you hear a strange noise.
Clack.
You feel a cold gun barrel pointed to the back of your head.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
But the intense hostility coming from behind stops any further actions from the Nightmare.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I don't need you to do anything, but I do have a few words for you.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I understand you have your own reasons, I pardon your calculations, I let you keep your secrets, and I'm willing to help you achieve your goal.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: In return, I only ask for your <color=#fb9259>loyalty</color>.
You hear a metallic click, an intense rush of power and bloodthirstiness gathering on something hidden deep in the barrel.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>This bullet</color> has been locked onto you. If you dare betray the DisCity... No matter when, no matter where, it can kill you.
You don't turn to look at Langley's gun. You step forward, walking straight toward the red luminous ring.
Where Hamel has disappeared, you touch the edge of the Black Ring for the first time. A white light envelopes you and swallows your consciousness...
